generalAbilities.name: Light Blindness
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

defensiveAbilities.name: Explosion
defensiveAbilities.description: When a Xotanispawn dies, it explodes, dealing 15d8 Fire Damage damage to creatures in a 30ft Emanation (Basic DC 39 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
60 feet. DC 36 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Internal Furnace
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature adjacent to the Xotanispawn touches it or hits it with a physical attack

Effect The triggering creature takes 5d8 Persistent,fire Damage damage (DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save to negate).

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The Xotanispawn sprays a 60ft Cone of magma that deals 10d10 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{10d10 fire damage and 2d6 persistent fire damage} to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 39 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The Xotanispawn can't use its Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Heat Surge
offensiveAbilities.description: When the Xotanispawn critically hits, its body surges with heat, increasing the damage of its Internal Furnace to 10d8 Persistent,fire Damage damage until the start of its next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
